# Leaf spring bushing torque procedure

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Torque the new leaf spring bushings to specification and plan to re-torque U-bolts. [t560]

## Tips & gotchas

- Plan to re-torque U-bolts after driving for a couple of hundred miles. [t560]
